title: Find the Maximum Number of Elements in Subset
summary: Choose occurrences from nums and arrange the selected values as an odd-length palindrome. Starting at x, repeatedly square to reach its single central value, then mirror the outward values. Maximize selected occurrence count; a singleton is valid.
pitfalls: Use multiplicities, not distinct-set membership. Ones require special handling because squaring one does not advance. Exponents double, rather than increase by one.
